page.notes: The first line of the body text ("ST HOC NON") is set in spaced capitals beside a woodcut ornamental initial; the initial itself is an ornament, not a readable letter, so only the printed capitals are given. The faint marks at the upper right edge are show-through or scan edge and were left out. The word "Ecclefiæq;" is partly worn in the scan; the letters given are the most likely reading.
